label: DS-10 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the single-gene DefensePredictor-discovered system 10 locus cataloged as working transcriptional unit ZAPB and whose plasmid expression in E. coli MG1655 reduced bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from the ZAPB source working identifier, the individual DS-10 gene and protein, the DS-10 HMM profile row, cloned-transcriptional-unit plaquing assays, the absent final Table S7 and HHPred-domain rows, the absent DefenseFinder rule-level model, unresolved DS-10 component activity and molecular output, and other DefensePredictor-discovered or phage-defense systems.
